title: Why Useful Videos Still Get Ignored
topic: How experts can make educational social videos easier to understand and worth watching
audience: founders and experts who teach through short social videos

narrative.hook: If your useful videos are getting ignored, the lesson may be arriving before the reason to care
narrative.problem: A lot of experts open with background, definitions, and context because they want every sentence to be accurate
narrative.stakes: But the viewer has not felt the problem yet, so every correct sentence starts to sound like homework
narrative.reframe: Start with a moment they recognize from their own day, then teach the fix
steps: name the frustrating moment in plain language
show the difference between the weak version and the stronger version
give one small action the viewer can try today

proof.statement: do not open with three principles of follow-up. Open with: your lead did not disappear; your follow-up gave them nothing easy to answer. Then show the better message

narrative.takeaway: The value is still the lesson. The hook simply gives the viewer a reason to stay long enough to receive it

cta.text: Use this structure on your next script, then save the result beside the old version and compare them
